Your data and your journey.

The booking service stores your name, phone number, password hash, account role, optional gender, verification status, trusted contact, trips, payment references and submitted safety reports. Passwords are hashed; sign-in tokens stay in app memory.

Location and sharing

Location is requested only when you choose to share it. Driver location updates are sent while the app is open with an active booking. Recent coordinates are visible to booked passengers and anyone given an active journey link. Links expire after two hours and are revoked when the journey ends; you can revoke them earlier. Coordinates older than two minutes are not displayed. Emergency location is shared through your device’s share menu only when you choose a recipient.

Payments

Cashfree handles payment entry. Planto-Ride stores order references and verified payment status, not card credentials. Payment is due after a completed journey; cancelled unstarted journeys have no online charge. Any refund or payment dispute requires operator assistance and Cashfree’s merchant process.

External services

Google Maps handles map and direction requests. Opening a map sends the requested route or coordinates to Google. Cashfree receives the customer and order information required to process your payment.

Before service launch

Account and driver verification is performed by the operator before booking or publishing journeys. The operator must publish its support contact, retention/deletion policy, cancellation and refund terms, service coverage and operating conditions before activating public bookings. Those operational arrangements are not established on this site yet. No staffed emergency response is claimed. In immediate danger call 112.
